title: Te Misiona i te Tāone Tawhito
intro: He tāone tawhito puehu, ko ōna tāngata kua mau tonu ki te whakakāhore, me te whakatūpato whakamutunga kāore i arohia. I tēnei rā, tū atu ki te tūranga o te hunga i tonoa e Allah ki te kawe karere ki tētahi iwi uaua. He kōrero mō te whakakāhore, he reo whakapono motuhake, me te mutunga i hiritia e tētahi ture whakangaro. Ko wai te kōrero mā roto i ēnei tohu?
clues: I tonoa mātou e Allah ki tētahi tāone kua tahuri kē tōna iwi i te pono
Tokorua mātou i tae tuatahi mai, kātahi ka tae mai tētahi tuatoru hei whakapakari i tā mātou kaupapa
I whakakahoretia mātou e te iwi, me te kī he tangata noa iho mātou pērā i a rātou
Kotahi te wairua i te pito rawa o te tāone i oma ki te kī atu ki te iwi kia whai i a mātou
I inoi mātou ki a rātou, engari i whakapakeketia e rātou ō rātou ngākau, ā, i tahuri ke mai ki a mātou
I roto i tētahi karanga whakamataku mai i te rangi, ka wahangu tō mātou tāone katoa

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Ngā Karere o te Tāone i roto i te Surah Ya-Sin
Te Hawwariyyun (Nga akonga a Isa)
Ngā Tohunga Makutu o te Kōti o Parao
Ngā Hoa o te Hāpati
Te Iwi o te Arewhana
identity.answer: Ngā Karere o te Tāone i roto i te Surah Ya-Sin

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I whakakahoretia, ā, i kiia he hunga teka e te tangata o te tāone
I tahuna oratia i roto i te ahi nui e mura ana
I horomia e te ika nui i te moana hohonu
I akiakihia kia mahi i te hanga i tētahi pou tiketike
I whakamamaetia i roto i te awaawa o te ahi mura
trial.answer: I whakakahoretia, ā, i kiia he hunga teka e te tangata o te tāone

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Te tāone tawhito (al-Qaryah)
He oumu nui e mura ana
Te puku o te ika nui
Ko te pou teitei e pa ana ki te rangi
Te Whare Tapu (Kaaba)

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakangaromia te tāone e te karanga whakangaro kotahi (Sayha)
I toremi te kaitukino me tana ope taua i te moana pakaru
I hurihia te iwi hei makimaki me ngā makimaki
I whakangaromia te tāone e te ua kōhatu i te rangi
I horomia te hapori katoa e te waipuke nui
outcome.answer: I whakangaromia te tāone e te karanga whakangaro kotahi (Sayha)

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
